import hashlib, json, math
from decimal import Decimal
def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
files = {}
for name in ['context.json','source-1CRN.pdb','sasa.json','report.json']:
    with open(name,'rb') as f: files[name]=f.read()
ctx=json.loads(files['context.json'])
report=json.loads(files['report.json']); r=report['result']
sasa_env=json.loads(files['sasa.json']); sasa=sasa_env['result']
up=[u for u in ctx['upstream'] if u['key']=='sasa'][0]; approval=up['approval']
review_bytes=approval['reviewFileUtf8'].encode('utf-8')
review=json.loads(review_bytes)
rows=sasa['residues']; row_sum=sum(x['area_A2'] for x in rows)
results={
  'source_sha256': sha(files['source-1CRN.pdb']),
  'upstream_sha256': sha(files['sasa.json']),
  'report_sha256': sha(files['report.json']),
  'review_sha256': sha(review_bytes),
  'review_size': len(review_bytes),
  'approval_verdict': approval['verdict'],
  'original_review_verdict': review['result']['verdict'],
  'reviewedArtifact_matches': approval['reviewedArtifact']['sha256']==sha(files['sasa.json']) and approval['reviewedArtifact']['size']==len(files['sasa.json']),
  'reviewArtifact_matches': sha(review_bytes)==approval['reviewArtifact']['sha256'] and len(review_bytes)==approval['reviewArtifact']['size'],
  'report_total_A2': r['total_A2'],
  'sasa_total_A2': sasa['total_A2'],
  'total_match': r['total_A2']==sasa['total_A2'],
  'report_units': r['units'],
  'report_source_sha256': r['source_sha256'],
  'report_upstream_sha256': r['upstream_sha256'],
  'residue_sum_A2': row_sum,
  'abs_sum_diff_A2': abs(row_sum-sasa['total_A2']),
  'sum_within_0.001': abs(row_sum-sasa['total_A2'])<=0.001,
  'report_schema_source_sha256_ok': r['source_sha256']==ctx['resultSchemas']['report']['properties']['source_sha256']['const'],
  'report_repro_code_sha256': r['reproduction']['code_sha256'],
  'report_repro_code_actual_sha256': sha(r['reproduction']['code'].encode('utf-8')),
  'report_repro_residues_match_sasa': [x['residue_id'] for x in r['reproduction']['residues']]==[x['residue_id'] for x in rows] and [x['area_A2'] for x in r['reproduction']['residues']]==[x['area_A2'] for x in rows],
}
print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
